name: Young Ladies
overview: Scripture portrays young ladies as precious and valuable, likened to polished cornerstones and jewels of great worth, emphasizing the importance of discretion and virtue over mere outward beauty. True honor and strength adorn a woman who fears the LORD, and her trust should rest wholly in Him rather than in her own understanding. This Christ-centered wisdom calls young ladies to cultivate inner character and godly reverence as the foundation for a life that will be praised and bring lasting joy.
